blurb: Gray Line Toronto offers guided tours from Toronto to various destinations including Niagara Falls, Niagara-on-the-Lake, and Algonquin. Tours include bus, boat, and walking options with durations ranging from 90 minutes to 12 hours. Guests experience local culture, natural attractions, and historic sites with knowledgeable guides.

quotes.author: A fantastic tour!
quotes.text: We had a brilliant day trip from Toronto to Niagara Falls. The day was perfectly timed with just enough time at each activity. The boat trip was smooth and a real highlight getting so close to the falls. The hour in Niagara on the Lakes was super too. Alex was a fantastic guide, helpful and informative and kept us all on track. The driving was all very efficient. Would highly recommend this tour - excellent value for money and a great day trip out of Toronto to see one of the highlights of the world!

quotes.author: Very nice tour
quotes.text: Great tour! I recommend it because it combines the boat tour (a must if you are visiting the Falls), some time to enjoy the views from above and a stop at Niagara-on-the-Lake historic town. If possible I would recommend making a bit longer stop at this historic town, 15 min or half an hour more. Alex, our guide was very good, giving the perfect tips and explanations.

quotes.author: A First Time Adventure
quotes.text: Luis and Hugo were great guides! We appreciated Luis's low key but very knowledgeable and interesting presentation. The tour was efficient and well-timed. While the lunch buffet and maple syrup tasting were not choices we would make again, The Falls boat ride and Niagara on the Lake were wonderful. All-in-all a great day!

quotes.author: Day trip to Niagara Falls
quotes.text: Great trip to Niagara Falls and Niagara by the Lake. -driven by Ricky and looked After by Alex the tour guide. Both staff were courteous and respectful at all times. I Highly recommend the trip using the Gray line company

quotes.author: Great communication and a comfortable journey.
quotes.text: Alex has a vibrant energy and is so kind and likeable. No question was too much and she took care of us from start to finish but not in an over bearing way. Great communication throughout the trip. Highly recommend

Had an amazing day trip of Niagara Falls , Niagra on the lake and Maple tasting with Alex and Rick Alex gave us all the right and relevant inputs to make the trip interesting and managed the time very well.
